newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CNA GAllo shares tumble on dull results.
newsitem.headline: CNA GAllo shares tumble on dull results.

text.p: Shares in leading South African retailer CNA Gallo Ltd tumbled on Wednesday on the back of the company's lacklustre year-end results, dealers said.
By 0903 GMT CNA was down five cents at 365 cents amid very small volumes.

"They announced weaker-than-expected results yesterday and that's why the share price is just drifting off. They have also issued a cautionary on restructuring, so anything can happen," one dealer said.
CNA's headline earnings per share for the year-ended March 31 were 24.1 cents compared to 25.8 cents previous year, while dividends were held steady at 10.5 cents.
Results were at the bottom end of analysts' consensus forecasts, polled by Reuters last week.
Analysts had forecast earnings per share within a range of 24.5 cents to 26.8 cents, while dvidends were ranged between 10.5 cents and 11.1 cents.
